name: Eureshya
source:
A seventh-ranked Angel who was created by one of the Gods of the Old Pantheon, she is discovered when the travelling merchant Kashram explores a ruin on his way to Grasesta. As a "renegade angel" who has lost her master, she follows Kashram to Grasesta where she is promptly presented as a gift to King Salo. Salo in turn relinquishes his right of ownership over her and uses her as a bonus prize for the winner of the upcoming Artisans tournament, which causes a considerable amount of distress to her.

[Spoiler] If Judar wins the tournament, he becomes Eureshya's new master. She is originally hostile to him at the start, but she also discovers her powers of healing have been negatively impacted by her long dormancy. Eureshya eventually discovers that her creator, having lost in the Great War of the Gods in ages past and was destroyed, also robbed her of the main source of divine power which fuelled her healing spells. 

If Judar loses patience with Eureshya's botched healing spells, he can turn her over to Lucille's brothel where she spends the rest of her days as a prostitute. If he does not, he finds a location in the Black Pit where Eureshya can make a new contract with the Moon Goddess Lyucien, which restores her healing abilities back to normal and convinces her to pledge her allegiance to him as his "Guardian Angel".

Eureshya is the main focus of the AP01 storyline as Angels from Eushully's other games make a bid to supplant her as Judar's guardian angel. [/Spoiler]
